name: Altavista IT Knowledge Ontology
description: Conceptual model of the Altavista knowledge base. Version 2.0 extends the Phase I model (Document, Category, Concept) with knowledge domains, concept-to-concept relations, and document-to-document relations derived from the system.

classes.Document: A unit of knowledge in the repository (policy, ticket, FAQ, or meeting minutes).
classes.Category: The document type assigned by the classifier: Policy/Process, Support/Incidents, FAQ, or Minutes.
classes.Concept: A business or technical topic mentioned in documents, detected with the keyword lexicon below.
classes.Domain: A knowledge area that groups related concepts.

relations.belongs_to: Document -> Category (label from the corpus, or predicted by the classifier for new documents)
relations.mentions: Document -> Concept (at least one concept keyword appears in the title or text)
relations.related_to: Concept <-> Concept (the two concepts are mentioned together in at least 3 documents)
relations.similar_to: Document <-> Document (hybrid cosine similarity above the configured threshold)
relations.governed_by: Ticket, FAQ, or Minutes -> the most similar Policy/Process document that shares a concept

categories.Policy/Process: Rules and procedures that define how work must be done.
categories.Support/Incidents: Records of tickets and incidents and how they were solved.
categories.FAQ: Self-service answers to frequent user questions.
categories.Minutes: Decisions and agreements from meetings and committees.

domains.Information Security: Threats, incidents, data protection, and awareness.
domains.Infrastructure & Operations: Servers, storage, networks, backups, and changes.
domains.End-User Support: Devices, software, and day-to-day help for employees.
domains.People & Governance: Employee lifecycle, service levels, and knowledge management.
